class.name: NNCustomSearchCriterion
class.brief_description: Calls a script-defined [code]apply_criterion(node)[/code] method to filter and score candidate nodes.
class.description: With the custom search criterion, you attach a script that defines [code]apply_criterion(node: Node)[/code]. For each candidate node in the search space, [member NNNQSSearchCriteria.is_filtered] is reset to [code]false[/code] and [member NNNQSSearchCriteria.score] is reset to [code]1.0[/code] before [code]apply_criterion(node)[/code] is called with the candidate [Node]. Inside [code]apply_criterion(node)[/code], set [member NNNQSSearchCriteria.is_filtered] to [code]true[/code] to filter the node out, and set [member NNNQSSearchCriteria.score] to the desired score. If no [code]apply_criterion[/code] method is defined on the script, nodes are left unfiltered with a score of [code]1.0[/code].
